title: Blackmaw's Treasure
story: After a thundering duel on the cliff road, Mr 6 defeats Blackmaw the Bandit Lord and recovers his plunder: three chests holding 24, 36, and 18 gold coins. Mr 6 vows to give half of all the treasure to the village orphanage.
question: How many gold coins does the orphanage receive?
hint: First add all three chests: 24 + 36 + 18. Then find half of the total.
victory: Thirty-nine gold coins buy the orphanage new beds, a library, and a very round pony named Biscuit. Blackmaw, sentenced to read bedtime stories there every night, secretly loves his new job.
solution: Add the three chests: 24 + 36 + 18 = 78 coins in all.
praise: Adding the chests together was the perfect first move — the halving step was the one that slipped by.
